description: A flex item with a zero basis is as narrow as its share of the row, so its text wraps at the longest word instead of overflowing

florui.css: .row { display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 10px; width: 300px; font-size: 14px; color: #fff; } .a { flex-grow: 2; flex-basis: 0; background-color: #446; padding: 10px; } .b { display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex-grow: 1; flex-basis: 0; background-color: #644; padding: 10px; }

children.text: Bruno shared Brand assets with Design

classification.reason: Geometry matches Chromium within 0.4px; the remaining difference is text antialiasing (about 5% of pixels measured), as in the other fixtures that render text.
